lines.text: Um, I, I love this song, I think it's a sleeper on the album
Uh, it, it tells a story about a girl, you know
A girl who, who kinda knows what she wants in life
And, and doesn't really care what people think about her
Um, you know, just everyone has those girlfriends that they
Think are a little crazy, and you know, maybe don't keep it classy all the time
But they just don't really care about all that
And kinda just go after what they want
And so, really, it's about a girl that people may look at her as weak
But in reality, she's stronger than anybody else
